title: Analysis of First-Order Linear Pursuit and Evasion Differential Games with Gronwall-Type Constraints
summary: We examine pursuit and evasion problems in the space $ \mathbb{R}^{n} $ involving a lone pursuer and evader. Motion of each player is governed by a first-order linear differential equation. The players' control functions are subject to the Gronwall-type inequality. The game's duration is fixed and represented by a positive number $\vartheta $. When the state of a pursuer coincides with that of the evader, we then say the pursuit is completed.
